verdict.rationale: Angular ships first-party routing (@angular/router) and server-side rendering via Angular Universal (angular-comm-5, angular-docs-3), giving built-in full-stack routing/data-fetching capability, but there is no evidence of a distinct 'meta-framework' product (akin to Next.js/Nuxt/SvelteKit) built on top of Angular — these features are part of the core framework itself rather than a separate official layer. Missing for 10: an official standalone meta-framework product, documented data-fetching/loader APIs, and independent corroboration of a full-stack meta-framework experience.
